procedures.name: UpdateMostRecentReinspection
procedures.doc: Marks the current inspection as the most recent reinspection and clears that flag on earlier reinspections.

procedures.doc: Clears the most-recent flag on earlier reinspections with the same inspection number.

procedures.doc: Sets the test value on the uniquely matching line of the current inspection.

procedures.doc: Opens assist edit for the uniquely matching test line of the current inspection.

procedures.doc: Updates the inspection result from the first applicable line result, prioritizing acceptable-quality-level failures.

procedures.doc: Reopens a finished inspection after permission, reinspection, and confirmation checks.

procedures.doc: Logs feature usage and finishes the inspection with interactive confirmation.

procedures.name: FinishInspectionAndPrompt
procedures.doc: Finishes an open inspection after permission, tracking, and optional confirmation checks.

procedures.name: GetReservedInventory
